answer: Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. The zenith holds work receipts rather than names, so the nadir of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. The design leans on staked peer review with spot checks, reduced by each unverified claim, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool. The fable of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy.
